Corsha | Tysons, VA (Hybrid) | Full-time

Corsha is a cybersecurity startup in the DC area. We offer a dual-use cybersecurity product for Operational Technology (OT) environments to our customers. Our mission is to secure the Operational Systems that run our world!

We are seeking technical roles across product development, data science, and ot security engineers. We are a mission driven company and want to bring on like-minded folks interested in making a difference!

Easiest way to apply is through the job links below but reach out if folks have any questions!

Current jobs we have open: - Data Scientist: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4339829577/ - Backend Software Engineer: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4339489650/ - OT Security Engineer: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4339819841/
